decisions.reason: The air quality sensor fits sustained demand for indoor climate measurement and costs little to carry in a modular catalog, so the option stays open.
The MQTT proxy costs almost nothing to keep, but native MQTT support in newer firmware and bindings may make it redundant, so the risk of retiring it is notable though not yet decisive.
The CAN bus module serves a niche automation need with unclear volume, but its holding cost is low and industrial customers value long availability, so it is kept for now.
Interest in CO2 monitoring grew strongly during the pandemic years, which strengthens the case for this option rather than abandoning it.
The touch panel accessory still has uncertain demand, but it complements display and control projects at low holding cost, so it stays in the catalog while evidence accumulates.
